about.title: RX Direct ke baare mein
about.subtitle: Pakistan mein bharosemand, verified gharelu staff ka barhta hua network.
about.story1: RX Direct is masle ko hal karne ke liye bana jo Pakistan ka har ghar jhelta hai: aisa gharelu staff dhoondna jis par sach mein bharosa kiya ja sake. Jo kaam pehle sirf sunni sunai baat aur andaze par hota tha, ab ek baqaida, verified tareeqe se hota hai.
about.story2: {year} se hum Islamabad, Rawalpindi aur doosre bare shehron mein hazaron cook, driver, helper, cleaner, guard aur office boy gharon aur karobar mein laga chuke hain, har ek background check, interview aur client ki zaroorat ke mutabiq match ke baad.
about.missionText: Pakistan ke har ghar aur karobar ke liye gharelu staff rakhna mehfooz, tez aur shaffaf banana.
about.value1Desc: Har staff member client se milne se pehle verify hota hai.
about.value2Desc: Saaf fee aur hamesha seedhi baat.
about.value3Desc: Har staff member ke liye munsifana tankhwah aur izzat wala sulook.
about.value4Desc: Jo waqt hum dete hain, us par kaam kar ke dikhate hain.
about.registeredText: RX Direct ek qanooni tor par registered aur SECP certified company hai (CUIN 0347436), koi ghair rasmi operator nahi. Aap kisi bhi waqt hamari registration aur incorporation certificate dekh sakte hain.

faqsPage.subtitle: Families aur karobar ki taraf se sab se zyada poochhe jane wale sawalon ke jawab.

pricingPage.title: Tankhwah aur fee
pricingPage.subtitle: RX Direct ke zariye gharelu staff aur ghar ki marammat ki services ki fee kaise lagti hai.
pricingPage.intro: Koi fixed price list nahi hai, kyunke bare ghar ka live-in cook aur chhote flat ka part-time cleaner alag alag kharch rakhte hain. Is liye hum WhatsApp par mukhtasar baat ke baad aap ki zaroorat ke mutabiq batate hain, taake aap ko faisle se pehle poora kharch maloom ho.
pricingPage.factorsTitle: Kharch kin cheezon par depend karta hai
pricingPage.noHidden: Jo bhi figure ho, baad mein koi chhupi hui fee nahi lagti. Jo hum pehle confirm karte hain wohi aap dete hain, aur woh sirf placement confirm hone par lagti hai.
pricingPage.categoriesText: Ghar ka staff (cook, chef, maid, helper, cleaner, nanny, mali) aam tor par is baat par depend karta hai ke kaam live-in hai, live-out ya part-time. Office aur security staff (driver, guard, office boy) aam tor par mahana tay hota hai, overtime jaise extra kaam ke saath. Nursing aur care staff (home nurse, caretaker) shift ki lambai aur care ki noiyat par depend karta hai. Marammat ka staff (electrician, plumber, carpenter, painter) aik visit ke liye ya regular maintenance ke liye book ho sakta hai.

jobsPage.title: RX Direct ke saath kaam karein
jobsPage.subtitle: Cook, driver, helper, nurse, electrician ya kisi aur kaam ki naukri chahiye? Hamari list mein shamil hone ka tareeqa yeh hai.
jobsPage.intro: RX Direct trained aur bharosemand workers ko Pakistan bhar ke un gharon aur karobar se jorta hai jo verified staff chahte hain. Agar aap ko khana pakane, driving, safai, bachon ki dekh bhaal, nursing, buzurgon ki dekh bhaal, ya electrician, plumber, carpenter ya painter ke kaam ka tajurba hai, to hum aap se baat karna chahte hain.

jobsPage.requirement2: Pichle kaam ke tajurbe ki details, references ke saath jin se hum rabta kar sakein
jobsPage.requirement3: Chhote se interview ke liye aana, aur kuch kaamon ke liye amli maharat ka test
jobsPage.ctaSubtitle: Apne CNIC, tajurbe aur jis kaam mein dilchaspi hai us ki details ke saath WhatsApp par message karein.
